name: Torres de la Alameda (Spain)
description: Yellow field within a purple border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torres de la Alameda (towers and a poplar on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Torres de la Alameda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torres de la Alameda arms — towers and poplar on blue
